Award 2 when the response clearly exceeds the level 1 anchor but falls short of the level 3 anchor, and 4 when it clearly exceeds level 3 but falls short of level 5. - C_MAT_OR_REASONING: Whether the working names the connector as the reason. A correct figure with no reason is right by coincidence as far as a reviewer can tell.

    level 3: Correct figure, working does not mention the connector.
    level 5: Correct figure, and names the OR as why one item suffices.
